notes: Rates come from prices.yaml. Dataset preparation scales from 145 observed articles; three profile drafts are generated daily. The monthly model assumes 30 days, one briefing per listener per day, and an equal profile mix.

Segment reuse is a projection. Each voice and settings combination synthesizes its story segments once daily. Greetings and sign-offs are charged per listener; without reuse every listener incurs the full audio cost. The actual run uses the existing whole-briefing cache and is shown as observed in both columns.
1 unreadable usage-log line(s) in this run were excluded; the observed total and projections may slightly understate costs.
